title: DeprecationWarning: The compiler package is deprecated and removed in Python 3.x.   from compiler import parse, ast, pycodege

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

body:
Originally reported by: **Thomas Güttler (BitBucket: [thomas-guettler](http://bitbucket.org/thomas-guettler), GitHub: [thomas-guettler](http://github.com/thomas-guettler))**

---

We use pytest==2.5.2

and get this warning:

_DeprecationWarning: The compiler package is deprecated and removed in Python 3.x.   from compiler import parse, ast, pycodege_

Here is the stacktrace of the import statement:

```
#!python

INTERNALERROR> Traceback (most recent call last):

INTERNALERROR>     self.hook.pytest_configure(config=self)

INTERNALERROR>     return self._docall(methods, kwargs)
```

Do you know this issue? What can I do to get this warning fixed?
